review_method: Visual inspection of every second decoded frame across the entire MP4 plus native-resolution transition frames, followed by native initial PNG
initial_scene: Middle third-person view only: a rear-mounted white-and-blue robotic arm has its open gripper above an orange tabletop mat. Four round buttons with black bases are visible: green at rear left, blue below it, yellow toward the front center-right, and red at rear right. An orange round fruit-like object sits left of center; a green cucumber-shaped object, yellow oval object, orange elongated fruit-like object, and purple grape-like cluster lie along the front. A second robot is partly visible at lower left and stays inactive.

observed_sequence.action: The active rear arm waits above the mat; its initially open gripper closes into a narrow downward-pointing tip before approaching a button. Incidental fruit-like objects and the foreground robot remain stationary.
The rear arm advances its closed gripper toward the green rear-left button and lowers the tip over its center. Phase boundaries are approximate from dense frame inspection.

The closed gripper tip contacts and presses the green button. The green center visibly brightens during contact, including native frames 126 and 142, establishing successful activation rather than merely hovering.

The arm releases the green button and lifts its closed gripper clear, returning to a raised position. The green button is no longer brightly illuminated and remains in place; withdrawal is complete by frames 153–156.
The raised gripper briefly holds clear above the mat after the first completed press.
The arm moves to the blue button directly below the green one and lowers the closed tip toward its center.
The closed gripper presses the blue button; the blue center visibly brightens in native frame 246.
The arm releases the blue button and lifts clear.
The arm moves toward the yellow front button and lowers its closed gripper onto the button center.
The closed gripper presses the yellow button. Its center visibly brightens during contact, clearly in native frame 340.
The arm releases the yellow button, raises the gripper and redirects toward the rear-right red button.
The arm positions the closed gripper above the red button and descends.
The closed gripper tip rests against the red button and makes a downward pressing motion. The button contact is visible, although its illumination change is less distinct than for the other buttons.
The arm releases the red button, opens the gripper while lifting away, and withdraws to its raised starting region. All buttons and fruit-like objects remain on the tabletop.

selected_segment.reason: Retain the first complete independent button press, including preparation, green-button contact/activation, release and complete visible withdrawal. Native frames 153–157 confirm that the gripper is clear and stable, before the second button approach begins around frame 179.
selected_segment.terminal_state: The green button has been pressed and released; its illumination has subsided, and the closed gripper is raised clear above the tabletop. The other three buttons remain untouched in the retained segment.

full_sequence_prompt: The robotic arm presses the green, blue, yellow, and red buttons in that order with its closed gripper, releasing each button before pressing the next, then lifts clear. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
world_model_prompt: The robotic arm presses the green button with its closed gripper, then lifts clear. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
uncertainties: Phase start/end indices are approximate except for the deliberately checked selected cutoff. Button travel is partly hidden by the gripper tip; green, blue and yellow activation is supported by visible brightening. Red contact and downward motion are clear, but a distinct red illumination change cannot be confidently established from this middle view.
